Great food, great atmosphere, and outstanding service. I'll definitely be back.

This restaurant provides a pleasant experience right from the moment you enter. Clean, cosy space, suitable for both family dining and meeting friends. The food is beautifully presented, the taste is stable, especially the typical dishes of the restaurant are quite worth trying.

The most impressive of them is my friend Ly. The serving is very enthusiastic, always blooming and paying attention to the guests. I don’t need to call many times that you’ve been actively supporting, from introducing the food to checking if you need anything extra. The way of drinking is pleasant, creating a feeling of comfort and care.

Overall, this is a place worth returning, not just for the food but also for the quality of service, especially thanks to staff like Ly.
